name: Elegant Marbles and Grani Industries Limited
summary: Elegant Marbles & Grani Industries Ltd. specializes in the marble and granite sector, manufacturing and distributing an array of stone products, including tiles and slabs fashioned from marble, granite, and various other natural stones. Its comprehensive product offering extends to travertine, exclusive "di lusso" collections, gemstones, glass stones, and artistic embellishments and accessories. Founded on November 5, 1984, by Rajesh Ramswaroop Agrawal and Rakesh Ramswaroop Agrawal, the company's corporate headquarters are situated in Mumbai, India.
